verdict.rationale: Lambda's pricing page says to "contact us for reserved capacity at our lowest prices," which confirms discounted reserved capacity exists. It is reached only through sales. The documented self-serve offerings (on-demand instances and 1-Click Clusters) explicitly have no long-term commitments. Private Cloud and large production clusters suggest committed arrangements, but no terms are documented. Missing for 10: self-serve reservation or commit purchase flow, documented commitment terms and discount levels, API or console management of reservations, independent corroboration.
